long_description: Build amazing structures, interact with players, and survive in worlds with unique game modes designed specifically for NightWorlds

banner.description: A Minecraft SMP. Moderated multilingual community. Stable and performant.

clientmods.title: Client mods
clientmods.description: A wide range of supported client mods. Voice chat, emotes, animations, chunk loading up to 1000 chunks, and inventory animations.

mechanics.title: Vanilla mechanics
mechanics.description: All vanilla mechanics work as intended. Any farm, mechanism, or functional building will work as it does in singleplayer. If it doesn't, we'll refund your money.

pushable_block_entities.title: Pushable block entities
pushable_block_entities.description: Chests, hoppers, droppers, and other block entities can be pushed around with pistons or fly machines.

currencies.title: Organized economy
currencies.description: Currencies are protected from uncontrolled inflation. Also, they can have their own texture.

special_recipes.title: Special recipes
special_recipes.description: Special recipes are added to make the game easier. For example, you can turn sandstone into sand with a stonecutter or melt mud into clay in one step.

proxies.title: Low ping
proxies.description: Servers have regional proxies created to reduce latency during gameplay. You always connect to the nearest server, and play with everyone together.

automated_whitelist.title: Easy start
automated_whitelist.description: Whitelist is fully automated. You can start playing right after registration.

long_term_support.title: Long-term support
long_term_support.description: Unlike most SMPs, NightWorlds have been around for 5 years. We're not stopping anytime soon.
